nodes.label: Adapter Layer (per-marketplace)
nodes.rationale: One adapter per marketplace implementing a shared interface (fetch_offers, fetch_orders, update_prices, health_check); registered in a central registry so the core engine never contains marketplace-specific logic; new integrations do not require changes to the engine

nodes.label: Immutable Audit Trail
nodes.rationale: Immutable audit logs for every pricing action are required for compliance and provide a decision trace (why a price changed); chosen over mutable logs to prevent retroactive editing of price-change records
